content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bathinda Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Bathinda Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AIIMS Bathinda Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bathinda Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Palliative Care Doctor: MBBS with valid state medical council registration. Minimum 1-2 years of experience in a healthcare setup. Psychologist: M.A./M.Sc./M.Phil/PhD in Psychology from a recognized university.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bathinda Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Palliative Care Doctor: ₹ 1,00,000/- per month (consolidated) Psychologist: ₹ 40,000/- per month (consolidated)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bathinda recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via Google Form is 06 August 2026. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in AIIMS Bathinda recruitment?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bathinda is recruiting for the posts of Palliative Care Doctor and Psychologist.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there for these posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with one post for Palliative Care Doctor and one for Psychologist.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Palliative Care Doctor post?
faq.answer: The qualification required is MBBS with valid state medical council registration and a minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a healthcare setup.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Psychologist post is ₹ 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Bathinda recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bathinda recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the AIIMS Bathinda office. Specific details regarding the venue and reporting time are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and potentially a Written Exam, as indicated in the official notification.
